name: Acceptance suite-3 test 82 - question-mark wildcard inside a user Principal ARN is invalid
note: IAM-1004 (Phase 10) Campaign D: validation must cover both '*' and '?'. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/deployer? uses a single-character '?' glob inside the Principal-element ARN, which the IAM Principal element does not support - same blocked/failed outcome as test 81 (TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL located at Principal.AWS[0], INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN in coverage, no plain cross-account expansion).
